name: io.github.codespar/mcp-malga
description: MCP server for Malga — Brazilian payments orchestrator. Single API across multiple acquirers (Cielo, Rede, Stone, Adyen) with card, Pix, and boleto support.

environmentVariables.name: MALGA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Tenant identifier sent as X-Client-Id header on every request.

environmentVariables.name: MALGA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret key sent as X-Api-Key header on every request.

environmentVariables.name: MALGA_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Defaults to sandbox (https://sandbox-api.malga.io). Set to "false" for production (https://api.malga.io).
